mcq.QUESTION_DESC: The general one-dimensional time-dependent heat diffusion equation (without internal heat generation) is ________. A. $$ B. $$ C. $$ D. $$
The general solution to the steady-state 1D heat equation $\frac{d^2 u}{dx^2} = 0$ is ________. A. $$ B. $$ C. $$ D. $$
A boundary condition of the form \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}(0, t) = 0\) represents _________.

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Solve heat equation with } u(0,t)=0, u(10,t)=0, u(x,0)=3\sin(\pi x/5)+2\sin(2\pi x/5).\)

(1 Mark)

\(\text{General solution: } u(x,t)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{10} e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t/100}.\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{At } t=0: 3\sin(\pi x/5)+2\sin(2\pi x/5) = \sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{10}.\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Note: } \pi x/5 = 2\pi x/10, \ 2\pi x/5 = 4\pi x/10. \text{ So } B_2=3, B_4=2, \text{ other } B_n=0.\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Hence } u(x,t)=3\sin\frac{2\pi x}{10} e^{-\alpha^2 4\pi^2 t/100} + 2\sin\frac{4\pi x}{10} e^{-\alpha^2 16\pi^2 t/100}.\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{A bar of length 10 cm has ends at } 0^\circ\text{C}. \text{ Initial temperature is } u(x,0)=3\sin\frac{\pi x}{5}+2\sin\frac{2\pi x}{5}. \text{ Find } u(x,t).\)

sq.ANSWER:
Upto the stepMarks

\(\text{Conditions: } u(0,t)=0, u(l,t)=0, u(x,0) \text{ as given.}\)

(1 Mark)

\(\text{General solution: } u(x,t)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t/l^2}.\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{At } t=0: u(x,0) = \sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l}.\)

(1 Mark)

\(\text{Fourier sine coefficients: } B_n = \frac{2}{l} \left[ \int_0^{l/2} x \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} dx + \int_{l/2}^l (l-x) \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} dx \right].\)

(2 Mark)

\(\text{Evaluate: } B_n = \frac{4l}{n^2\pi^2} \sin\frac{n\pi}{2}. \text{ For odd } n, B_n = \frac{4l}{n^2\pi^2}(-1)^{(n-1)/2}.\)

(1 Mark)

\(\text{Hence } u(x,t) = \frac{4l}{\pi^2} \sum_{n=\text{odd}} \frac{(-1)^{(n-1)/2}}{n^2} \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t/l^2}.\)

(1 Mark)
sq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{A bar of length } l \text{ has ends at } 0^\circ\text{C}. \text{ Initial temperature is } u(x,0)=\begin{cases} x, & 0\leq x\leq l/2 \\ l-x, & l/2\leq x\leq l \end{cases}. \text{ Find } u(x,t).\)

lq.ANSWER:
Step Marks
\(\text{Steady state before change: \(u_s(x) = \dfrac{100}{l}x\) (linear).}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{After ends set to 0°C: heat equation \(u_t = \alpha^2 u_{xx}\) with BCs: \(u(0,t)=0\), \(u(l,t)=0.\)}\) (1 Mark)
\(\text{Initial condition: \(u(x,0)= u_s(x) = \dfrac{100}{l}x.\)}\) (1 Mark)
\(\text{General solution: \(u(x,t)= \sum B_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / l^2}.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{Determine \(B_n\) from \(u(x,0)= \sum B_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) = \dfrac{100}{l}x.\)}\) (1 Mark)
\(\text{\(B_n = \dfrac{2}{l} \int_0^l \dfrac{100}{l}x \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) dx = \dfrac{200}{l^2} \int_0^l x \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) dx.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{Compute integral: \(= \dfrac{200}{l^2} \left[ \dfrac{-l x \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right)}{n\pi} + \dfrac{l^2}{n^2\pi^2} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) \right]_0^l.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{Simplify: \(B_n = \dfrac{200}{n\pi} (-1)^{n+1}.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{Thus \(u(x,t)= \dfrac{200}{\pi} \sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty} \dfrac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / l^2}.\)}\) (2 Marks)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{A rod of length  $l$ has its ends kept at temperatures $0^\circ $C and $100^\circ$C until steady state.}\\ \text{Then the ends are suddenly reduced to $0^\circ$C. Find the subsequent temperature distribution.}\)

lq.ANSWER:
Step Marks
\(\text{Steady state initially: \(u_s(x) = 10x\) (since \((100/10)x\)).}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{After change: BCs: \(u(0,t)=0\), \(u(10,t)=0.\) Initial: \(u(x,0)=10x.\)}\) (1 Mark)
\(\text{General solution: \(u(x,t)= \sum B_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / 100}.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{\(B_n = \dfrac{2}{10} \int_0^{10} 10x \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) dx = 2 \int_0^{10} x \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) dx.\)}\) (2 Marks)
\(\text{Compute: \(= 2 \left[ \dfrac{-10x \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right)}{n\pi} + \dfrac{100}{n^2\pi^2} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) \right]_0^{10}.\)}\) (3 Marks)
\(\text{Simplify: \(= 2 \left[ \dfrac{-100 \cos(n\pi)}{n\pi} + 0 - 0 \right] = -\dfrac{200}{n\pi} \cos(n\pi) = \dfrac{200}{n\pi} (-1)^{n+1}.\)}\) (3 Marks)
\(\text{Thus \(u(x,t)= \dfrac{200}{\pi} \sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty} \dfrac{(-1)^{n+1}}{n} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / 100}.\)}\) (2 Marks)
lq.QUESTION_DESC: \(\text{A rod of length 10 cm has its ends kept at $0^\circ$ C and $100^\circ$ C until steady state.}\\ \text{Then the temperature at the far end ($100^\circ$ C) is suddenly reduced to $0^\circ$ C while the near end is maintained at $0^\circ$ C.}\\ \text{Find the temperature $u(x,t).$}\)
